sentences.en: Buzkashi is the famous horse game of Afghanistan.
sentences.target: بزکشي د افغانستان مشهوره آس لوبه ده.

sentences.en: A strong horse is worth more than gold.
sentences.target: پیاوړی آس له سرو زرو ډېر ارزښت لري.

sentences.en: The rider must carry the calf to the circle.
sentences.target: سپور باید سخی دایرې ته ورسوي.

sentences.en: Thousands of people watch from the hills.
sentences.target: زرګونه خلک له غونډیو ننداره کوي.

sentences.en: The winner brings honor to his village.
sentences.target: ګټونکی خپل کلي ته ویاړ راوړي.

sentences.en: Buzkashi is played in winter and spring.
sentences.target: بزکشي په ژمي او پسرلي کې کېږي.

sentences.en: It is a game of courage and skill.
sentences.target: دا د زړورتیا او مهارت لوبه ده.
